facts.fact: The Widow's Ladder's second ledge has its own anchor stone, a squat knuckle of rock worn smooth by ropes. The hard pitch's fifty-seven treads are short (a hand and a half each) and fall only about forty feet, inside the eight-span rope. Totals: 36, 34, 57 and a last pitch, 160 steps in all. The hamlets re-cut the steps every thaw, and Kunal walked it at eleven.

Revises F496: Ila has read every chronicle of the passes the survey office holds, and read her grandfather's 'carried down at the thaw' entry years ago over her father's shoulder. Nineteen is kept only for her oath (F497).
